subject.title: Guided /dashboard setup: assume the user has never heard of Tailscale

question: Should this issue stop at state-aware diagnosis and guidance, or should OpenClaw also add a generic gateway-owned API for consented Tailscale exposure changes from Telegram and future setup surfaces?
rationale: The mutation path changes security posture, persistent configuration, gateway lifecycle, rollback behavior, and plugin API ownership, which requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Guidance-first phase
options.body: Implement specific diagnosis, phone, server, and container instructions plus retry while leaving configuration changes in existing setup surfaces.

options.title: Generic consented setup API
options.body: Design a reusable gateway-owned operation for validated persistence, activation, rollback, and restart behavior before Telegram invokes it.

options.title: Copy and docs only
options.body: Simplify the error and link documentation without adding an in-product recovery flow.

recommendation.title: Guidance-first phase
recommendation.body: Implement specific diagnosis, phone, server, and container instructions plus retry while leaving configuration changes in existing setup surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history context for the dashboard flow and proposed follow-up, though final product approval still requires a repository maintainer.
